pages.text: There is $(bold)no random ore$(). Geolosys places metal in deposits: each of one kind, each large, each at its own depth. Iron may be a ten-minute walk; zinc may be the next valley over.$(br2)This is deliberate. Ore that is somewhere else is why wagons, ships and eventually trains exist.

Look for $(bold)samples$(): small rock clusters lying on the surface that show what is below. Dig straight down from a sample and you reach the deposit.$(br2)Ore blocks drop $(bold)clusters$(), not raw ore. Smelt them, or crush and wash them in Create for more.
One cluster, one ingot in a furnace. Create's crushing wheels and washing give more per cluster once you have them.

$(bold)Three metals are tied to terrain$() in this pack:$(li)$(bold)Iron (hematite)$(): everywhere, Y 32 to 60, the most common deposit$(li)$(bold)Zinc (sphalerite)$(): under mountains only, Y 37 to 46$(li)$(bold)Gold$(): dry country only (desert, badlands, savanna), Y -64 to 32$(br2)Everything else follows depth, not biome.
